newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat's Snia Bpd, Sorin suspended limit up in Milan.
newsitem.headline: Fiat's Snia Bpd, Sorin suspended limit up in Milan.

text.p: Fiat group units Snia Bpd and Sorin Biomedica were both suspended limit up when they touched a 10 percent ceiling in brisk trading on the Milan stockmarket, traders said.
Sorin heads up the bio-engineering activities of chemical holding Snia Bpd.
Traders said both stocks were recovering from sharp losses seen in recent weeks with some renewed talk of restructuring.
"These stocks have lost a lot in the past, especially following the failure of the SuperGemina operation in which they were both involved," one dealer said.

Fiat said in June it had no plans to sell off Snia Bpd but that it was open to new partners for the group. In May, Fiat chairman Cesare Romiti was preparing a medium to large disinvestment programme of non-strategic activities.
Attention focused on its four chemical companies after these were earmarked for disposal in a 1995 plan dubbed "SuperGemina" which was then shelved.
As part of the SuperGemina plan, Fiat was to offload Snia Bpd and its three operating companies Snia Fibre, chemicals group Caffaro and Sorin.
Before suspension, Sorin was quoted at 5,160 lire in volume of 260,000 shares and Snia Bpd was at 1,221 in volume of 1.16 million shares. -- Milan newsroom +392 66129589
